title: The WaveHoltz Heterogeneous Multiscale Method
summary: We consider the numerical solution of the wave equation in materials with rapidly varying coefficients, and time harmonic sources. For these problems, direct discretization is prohibitively costly, and instead multiscale methods are used. There are several multiscale methods that directly discretize in the frequency domain. In this work we instead start in the time-domain and combine a finite difference Heterogeneous Multiscale Method (HMM) for the wave equation with the WaveHoltz method.
